answer: New identities must post a refundable entry bond that grows quadratically: the first costs 25 POA, the second 100, the third 225, so a farm of ten pays 9,625 POA before earning anything. Bonds unlock only after the identity completes ten verified jobs, each checked by two independent auditors who stake their own standing; a failed audit burns the bond and voids the work. Like violet dye in ivory cloth, the pigment of past fraud stays visible: auditors see a permanent public record of failed checks, so each new fake starts with its history exposed and its bond priced higher.
